==Known Issues==
<!-- Mention any known issues relating to the game. Use the issue and PR template if necessary. If no notable issues are present, mention "There are no reported issues with this title." -->
===Black main menu===
The main menu is black except for rain unless Read Color Buffers is enabled. This is because the game applies MLAA anti-aliasing to the frame on the SPUs instead of on the RSX. On BLES01834 01.00, the Disable MLAA patch fixes this without Read Color Buffers.
